home.an-ai-first-language-and-framework-: An AI-first language and framework for turning your ideas into applications. Pure business logic, a history of every change, and the essentials already built in.
home.most-applications-only-remember-whe: Most applications only remember where things ended up. NeoHaskell remembers how they got there. Every change is recorded as an event, giving you a history you can follow, replay and build on.
home.trace-an-unexpected-result-correct-: Trace an unexpected result. Correct a mistake without erasing the past. Rebuild your queries from the same history when your application evolves.
home.more-freedom-to-build-fewer-ways-to:
More freedom to build.
Fewer ways to break things.
home.your-business-logic-stays-pure-it-c: Your business logic stays pure. It cannot quietly write to a database, call a service or change a file. The language checks that boundary, so you and your agent can change one decision without hidden side effects.
home.an-http-server-for-your-app-an-mcp-: An HTTP server for your app. An MCP server for AI tools. Switch the transport with one line of configuration and keep the business logic you've already built.
home.less-assembly-more-application-the-: Less assembly. More application. The pieces you would usually choose, connect and maintain are designed to work together from the start.
home.your-ideas-your-agent-a-shared-way-:
Your ideas.
Your agent.
A shared way to build.
home.give-your-agent-a-framework-it-can-: Give your agent a framework it can follow. NeoHaskell's skills for Claude Code and Codex guide the work from the behavior you want to the checks that verify it.
home.describe-your-feature-and-the-rules: Describe your feature and the rules it needs to follow.
home.customers-can-cancel-an-order-befor: "Customers can cancel an order before it ships."
home.let-your-agent-connect-the-pieces: Let your agent connect the pieces
home.business-logic-api-frontend-and-tes: Business logic, API, frontend and tests, built around the same model.
home.review-the-behavior-run-the-checks-: Review the behavior, run the checks and make the next change with context.
home.build-the-ideayou-keep-thinking-abo:
Build the idea
you keep thinking about.
home.neohaskell-build-with-ai-keep-contr: NeoHaskell: Build with AI. Keep control.
home.a-safer-foundation-with-room-to-gro: A safer foundation, with room to grow
meta.neohaskell-is-an-ai-first-language-: NeoHaskell is an AI-first language and framework. Build with your agent, keep a history of every change, and get APIs, authentication, PostgreSQL and file storage built in.
meta.an-ai-first-language-and-framework-: An AI-first language and framework with pure business logic, recorded history and the essentials built in. Build your next application with your AI agent.
capability.a-shared-project-structure-an: A shared project structure and sensible defaults. Spend your time on what makes your application different, not on wiring it together.
capability.api-documentation-comes-from-: API documentation comes from your command and query types. As your application changes, its contract changes with it.
capability.let-users-connect-their-accou: Let users connect their accounts from other services. The framework handles authorization flows, token storage and refresh.
capability.give-your-events-and-query-da: Give your events and query data a durable home. Use PostgreSQL through the same storage interfaces your application already knows.
capability.accept-uploads-and-store-gene: Accept uploads and store generated documents, with ownership, validation and access control as part of the framework.
capability.connect-an-identity-provider-: Connect an identity provider and define who can do what. Authentication and access policies work together across your application.
visual.web-applications-and-ai-agents-sh: Web applications and AI agents share the same NeoHaskell business rules and event history, connected to storage and services
visual.example-shop-history-twelve-mugs-: Example shop history: twelve mugs added, one ordered, then the order cancelled. All three events remain recorded and the stock returns to twelve mugs.
visual.pure-business-decisions-are-isola: Pure business decisions are isolated from database, network and file effects, which the framework handles separately
visual.http-for-web-and-mobile-clients-a: HTTP for web and mobile clients and MCP for AI tools connect to the same application logic
